cohort: The study included 200 parturient devoid of any co-morbidities undergoing elective caesarean section subjected to spinal anesthesia.
finding: A baseline finger perfusion index (P.I) >3.5 is significantly associated with a higher chance of post spinal hypotension in parturient undergoing elective caesarean section.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at fixed time intervals after spinal anesthesia during elective caesarean section.
